
## Load in Data

### Normalized quant file

```{r}
quant <- read.csv("10022026_A47_Fe_limited_iimn_gnps_quant.csv", header=T, check.names=F)

```

### Metadata

```{r}
md <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = T, check.names = F, sep = ',')
```

## Cleanup code

### Transpose the quant table

```{r}
quant <- t(quant)
quant <- as.data.frame(quant)

new_colnames <- as.character(quant[1, ])
quant <- quant[-1,]

colnames(quant) <- new_colnames

quant <- quant[grep(".mzML", rownames(quant)), ]


```

```{r}
numeric_columns <- sapply(quant, is.numeric)
numeric_columns

convert_to_numeric <- function(column) {
  as.numeric(as.character(column))
}

# Apply the function to all columns
quant <- quant %>% mutate_all(convert_to_numeric)
```

```{r}
quant <- quant %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("filename")

#quant$filename <- gsub(" Peak area", "", quant$filename)
```

### Merge feature table and metadata for plotting

```{r}
data_merge <- md %>% dplyr::select("filename", "ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type") %>% 
  left_join(quant, by = "filename")

data_merge <- md %>% dplyr::select("filename", "ATTRIBUTE_Strain") %>% 
  left_join(data_merge, by = "filename")

data_merge <- md %>% dplyr::select("filename", "ATTRIBUTE_OD_final") %>% 
  left_join(data_merge, by = "filename")

```

### Subset media blank and extraction blank

```{r}
data_merge <- data_merge %>% filter(ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type != "Method_Blank")
data_merge <- data_merge %>% filter(ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type != "Media_Blank")

```

### Set level to plot

```{r}
data_merge$ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type <- factor(data_merge$ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type, levels = c("Cl_added", "Ox_added","No_added"))
```

```{r}
data_2117 <- md %>% dplyr::select("filename", "ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type") %>%

data_2117  <- data_2117  %>%
  filter(!is.na(`2117`) & trimws(as.character(`2117`)) != "")
```

```{r}
anova_model <- aov(
  `2117` ~ ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type,
  data = data_2117
)

summary(anova_model)

TukeyHSD(anova_model)
```

```{r}
metallophore <- data_merge %>%
  ggplot( aes(x= ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type, y= `2117`, shape = ATTRIBUTE_Strain)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size= 3) +
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(y= "Peak Area (AU)", x= expression(paste("")), shape ="")+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),  
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),  
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust =1), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, color= "black"),
        axis.line=element_line(size =1),
        axis.ticks=element_line(size=1), 
        axis.ticks.length=unit(.25, "cm"),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14,family="sans"))

plot(metallophore)
ggsave(file="metallophore_adduct.png", plot=metallophore, width =5, height = 5 )
```

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(unique(data_merge$ATTRIBUTE_Strain), function(strain) {
  
  ggplot(
    subset(data_merge, ATTRIBUTE_Strain == strain),
    aes(x = ATTRIBUTE_Sample_Type, y = `2117`)
  ) +
    geom_line(linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
     scale_y_log10() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = strain,
      y = "Peak Area (AU)",
      x = "",
      shape = ""
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black",
        angle = 45, hjust = 1
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(.25, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 14, family = "sans"
      )
    )
})
plot_list[[1]]
plot_list[[2]]

lapply(seq_along(plot_list), function(i) {
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("metallophore_strain_", i, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_list[[i]],
    width = 5,
    height = 5,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300
  )
})

```

